product_context: native mobile app needing on-device performance profiling
missing_capability: iOS on-device memory and frame/hitch timing
diagnosed_risk: iOS performance regressions (memory growth, animation hitches) go undetected — ios_perf_snapshot only measures cold-launch time

product_context: mobile app requiring deep security review before release
missing_capability: mobile binary analysis (secrets, dataflow, dependency CVEs) beyond static manifest/Info.plist
diagnosed_risk: hardcoded secrets, insecure dataflow, and vulnerable dependencies in APK/IPA are not detected by the static manifest pass

product_context: mobile app team wanting a self-hosted real-device farm (multi-device Android + one iOS) driven from a single QA MCP host
missing_capability: multi-device orchestration — select/allocate a specific device by serial/UDID, lease and release devices so parallel sessions don't collide, and report per-device health (offline/unauthorized, battery, temperature)
diagnosed_risk: AndroidAllocator always binds to sorted(existing)[0], so with N attached devices every session grabs the same one — parallel runs collide, device matrix coverage silently collapses to one device, and dropped/unauthorized devices are invisible to the caller

product_context: mobile app team wanting a self-hosted real-device farm (multi-device Android + one iOS) driven from a single QA MCP host
missing_capability: real iOS device support (physical iPhone via WebDriverAgent/go-ios) — the kit's iOS path is Simulator-only
diagnosed_risk: iOS-only real-hardware behaviour (push delivery, biometrics, real payments/StoreKit, camera, cellular/low-connectivity, thermal and battery performance) cannot be tested at all through the kit
